senses.gloss:
n. (-न्तं)
The offering or performance of sacrifice.

ind.
A particle and preposition implying
1 Inferiority, (below, worse.)
2 Privation, (from.)
3 Separation, (away from.)
4 Contrariety, (against, opposite to.)
5 Difference, (from.)
6 Dishonesty.
7 Exultation: as अपकृष्टुं to revile, अपहर्त्तुं to take away, अपकर्त्तुं to do wrong, अपवक्तुं to contradict, अपकीर्त्ति infamy, &c.
E.
अ neg. and प from पा to preserve.

m. (-पः)
One of the eight demigods called Vasus.
E.
आप् to obtain, अच् aff.

m. (-प्यः)
The sign Aquarius.

n. (-णं)
1 Acting improperly, doing wrong.
2 Ill treating, offending, injuring.
E.
अप before, कृ to do, ल्युट् aff.

n. (-णं)
1 Payment, liquidation.
2 Removal, abstraction.
E.
अप and आङ् before कृ to make, ल्युट् aff.

mfn. (-र्त्ता-र्त्री-र्तृ)
Injurious, offensive, hostile, inimical, an enemy.
E.
अप before कृ to do, तृच् aff.

n. (-र्म्म)
1 Evil doing, wickedness.
2 Oppression, violence.
3 Laziness, incompetence.
4 Any impure or degrading act or rite.
E.
अप before, कर्म्मन् act.

m. (-ङ्क)
An indelible disgrace.
E.
अप before, कलङ्क a stain.

m. (-र्षः)
1 Pulling down, bringing low, lowering, depressing.
2 Inferiority, infamy, degradation. So अपकर्षण n. (णं.)
E.
अप before, कृष to attract, घञ् or ल्युट् aff.

m. (-रः)
1 Injury, offence, wrong, mischief.
2 Wickedness.
3 Tyranny, oppression.
4 Hatred, enmity.
E.
अप ill, and कार what does.

mfn. (-रः-री-रं)
Offensive, mischievous, unfriendly.
E.
अपकर offence, अञ् aff.

mfn. (-कः-का-क)
Injuring, pernicious.
E.
अप before, कृ to do, ण्वुल् aff.

f. (-गीः)
Reproach and menace.
E.
अपकार hatred, and गीर् speech.

mfn. (-री-रिणी-रि)
1 Offensive, oppressive.
2 Wicked, doing ill.
3 Mischievous, malicious.
4 Inimical.
E.
अपकार, and इनि aff.

mfn. (-र्थी-र्थिनी-र्थि)
Malicious, malevolent.
E.
अपकार and अर्थिन् who aims at.

f. (-र्तिः)
Infamy, disgrace.
E.
अप before, कीर्त्ति fame.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Done wrong, maliciously, offensively, or wickedly committed.
2 Who does wrong.
3 Ill treated.
4 Observed or practised as a degrading or impure act, as servile duties, funereal rites, &c.
E.
अप before, कृ to do, क्त aff.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Taken away, removed, destroyed, void of.
2 Paid.
E.
अप and आ before कृत made.

f. (-तिः)
1 Oppression, wrong, injury.
2 Enmity, opposition.
3 Any degrading or impure act or rite.
E.
अप before, कृ to do, क्तिन् aff.

f. (-तिः)
1 Removal, taking away.
2 Change of form or condition.
E.
अप and आ before कृति doing, or अप with आकृति form.

mfn. (-ष्टः-ष्टा-ष्टं)
1 Low, vile, inferior.
2 Perplexed, distressed.
3 Depressed, lowered, brought down.
E.
part. past. of कृष, with अप prefixed.

f. (-ता)
Inferiority, vileness. So अपकृष्टत्व n. (-त्वं.)
E.
तल् or त्व added to the last.

f. (-क्तिः)
1 Immaturity.
2 Indigestion.
E.
अ neg. पक्ति ripeness.

mfn. (-क्वः-क्वा-क्वं)
Unripe, immature.
E.
अ neg. पक्व ripe.

mfn. (-क्वः-क्वा-क्वं)
1 Half baked, crude, raw.
2 Nearly ripe, not quite ripe.
3 Undressed, what is eaten without further preparation, (as bread, &c.)
E.
आङ् diminutive, पक्व dressed, cooked.

f. (-ता)
Immaturity.
E.
अपक्व, and तल् affix: also with त्व, अपक्वत्वं.

m. (-मः)
1 Flight, retreat.
2 Passing off or away.
E.
अप from, and क्रम to go, with अच् aff.

n. (-णं)
Retiring, passing off or away.
E.
अप before, क्रम to go, ल्युट् aff.

f. (-या)
1 Oppression, offence.
2 Evil doing, wickedness.
3 Any impure act or rite.
E.
अप, and क्रिया action.

m. (-शः)
Reviling, abusing.
E.
अप against, क्रुश to call out, and घञ् aff.

mfn. (-क्षः-क्षा-क्षं)
Adverse, opposed to, not of the same side or party.
E.
अ neg. पक्ष a party.

mfn. (-क्षः-क्षा-क्षं)
Present, perceptible.
E.
अप before, and अक्ष an organ of sense, or अक्षि the eye.

f. (-ता)
Opposition, hostility.
E.
अपक्ष, and तल् affix: or with त्व affix अपक्षत्व.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Dead, deceased.
2 Gone, departed, remote, gone off.
E.
अप away, and गत gone.

m. (-मः)
Departure, separation, death.
E.
अप, and गम to go, affix अच्.

f. (-गा)
A river.
E.
अप down, below, or अप् water, and thence the sea; and गा what goes downward or into the sea; also आपगा.

f. (-गा)
A river, a stream.
E.
आप् a quantity of water, the ocean, and गा fem. derivative from गम to go.

m. (-नः)
A limb or member.
E.
अप, and घन from हन् to kill or hurt.

m. (-तः)
Striking or cutting off, killing.
E.
अप, and घात striking.

mfn. (-ती-तिनी-ति)
Murderous, killing.
E.
अपघात, and इनि aff.

m. (-यः)
1 Loss, privation.
2 Respect, obeisance.
E.
अप opposite to, and चय from चि to collect, with अच् aff.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Saluted, reverenced.
E.
अप here implying much or highly; and चायित part. past. of चाय to reverence.

m. (-रः)
1 Impropriety, defect, wickedness.
2 Observing unwholesome or improper regimen.
E.
अप before, त्तर to go, घञ् aff.

mfn. (-री-रिणी-रि)
Wicked, bad, one who acts wickedly.
E.
अपचार, and इनि aff.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Saluted, honoured.
2 Diminished, expended, wasted.
E.
अप before, चाय to reverence, or चि to collect, क्त aff.

f. (-तिः)
1 Loss.
2 Expense.
3 Annihilation.
4 Worship, reverence.
E.
अप before, चाय or चि, and क्तिन् aff.

f. (-ची)
1 Enlargement of the glands of the neck, &c.
2 Any indolent tumor.
E.
अ neg. पच to ripen, अङ् and ङीप् aff.

mfn. (-नः-ना-नं)
Wasting, perishing, departing.
E.
अप before, चि to collect, शानच् aff.

m. (-ता)
A spendthrift.
E.
अप, चि to collect, तृच् aff.

mfn. (-यः-या-यं)
1 Shadowless, having no shadow, as a deity or celestial being.
2 Having a bad or unlucky shadow.
f. (-या)
An unlucky shadow, a phantom.
E.
अप priv. छाया shadow.

n. (तं)
Simple elementary substance, not compounded of the five gross elements.
E.
neg. पञ्च five, कृत made, च्ची augment.

mfn. (-रः-रा-रं)
Adjoining, contiguous.
E.
अ neg. पट a screen, and अन्तर between.

f. (-टी)
A screen or wall of cloth, especially the kenāt or screen surrounding a tent.
E.
अ priv. and पट to go, with fem, termination ङीप्; preventing admission.

m. (-पः)
Precipitate entrance on the stage, indicating hurry and agitation: also read अपटाक्षेप.
E.
अपटी curtain, and क्षेप tossing.

mfn. (-टुः-टुः-ट्वी-टु)
1 Sick, diseased.
2 Awkward, not clever, uncouth.
3 Ineloquent.
E.
अ neg. पटु clever.

n. (-णं)
A defect in any of the senses.
E.
अपटु, and करण doing.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Unlearned, ignorant.
E.
अ neg. पण्डित learned.

m. (-कः)
Spasmodic contraction of the body, emprosthotonos.
E.
अप away, तन्त्र will, कन् aff.

n. (-णं)
Fasting, (in sickness.)
E.
अप bad, and तर्पण satisfaction.

m. (-कः)
Spasmodic contraction: see the last.
E.
अप down, तन to spread, ण्वुल् aff.

n. (-त्यं)
Offspring, male or female.
E.
अ neg. वत to fall, and यत् affix; the family being upheld by them.

f. (-दा)
A midwife.
E.
अपत्य offspring, and दा fem. deriv. who gives.

m. (-थः)
The vulva.
E.
अपत्य, and पथ the road.

m. (-यी)
A father who receives a gratuity from his son-in-law, a seller of his offspring.
E.
अपत्य, and विक्रयिन् who sells.

m. (-त्रुः)
A crab.
E.
अपत्य offspring, and शत्रु an enemy. The crab being said to perish on producing young.

mfn. (-पः-पा-पं)
1 Bashful, modest.
2 Immodest.
f. (-पा)
1 Bashfulness.
2 Want of shame, immodesty.
E.
अप, and त्रपा shame.

mfn. (-ष्णः-ष्णुः-ष्णु)
Bashful.
E.
अप before, त्रप to be ashamed, and इष्णुच् aff.

n. (-थं)
The absence of a road.
E.
अ priv. and पथ for पथिन् a road.

m. (-न्था)
See the preceding.

mfn. (-थ्यः-थ्या-थ्यं)
1 Unsuitable, inconsistent.
2 (In medicine) Contra-indicated, unfit as food or drink in particular complaints.
E.
अ neg. पथ्य suitable.

mfn. (-दः-दा or -दी-दं)
1 Footless, having no feet.
2 Having no place, no station.
adv. n. (-दं)
Unseasonably, inopportunely.
m. (-दः)
A reptile.
E.
अ neg. पद a foot.

fn. (-दा-दं)
Misfortune, calamity.
E.
आङ्, पद to go, अङ् and टाप्; also आपद्.

n. (-नं)
1 Approved occupation.
2 Work well or completely done.
E.
अप before, दा to give, and ल्युट् aff.

n. (-नं)
1 Removal, ablation, the sense of the fifth or ablative case.
2 Taking away.
E.
अप from, आदान taking.

n. (-कं)
See the above.
E.
कन् added.

mfn. (-रः-रा-रं)
Adjoining, contiguous.
n. (-रं)
Proximity, close, contiguity.
E.
अ neg. पद a foot, and अन्तर between.

m. (-र्थः)
Nonentity.
E.
अ neg. पदार्थ a thing.

n. or ind. (-शं)
Intermediate space, half a point of the compass.
E.
अप, and दिश to shew, क aff.

ind.
1 Dispersing, going or having gone to various quarters.
2 Having shewn or stated.
E.
अप before, दिश to show, व aff.

f. (-ता)
An evil spirit, a goblin.
E.
अप, and देवता a deity.

m. (-शः)
1 Evasion, prevarication.
2 Disguise by dress, &c.
3 Place, quarter.
4 A butt or mark.
5 Cause.
6 Fame, reputation.
7 A contrivance, a pretence, a pretext.
E.
अप ill, badly, &c. and दिश to shew, with धञ् aff.

n. (-व्यं)
1 An impurity, any bad thing.
2 Alloy, adulteration.
E.
अप, and द्रव्य thing.

m. (-सः)
Degradation, disgrace.
E.
अप, and ध्वंस loss.

m. (-जः)
A man of a mixed or impure cast.
E.
अपध्वंस and ज born.

mfn. (-स्तः-स्ता-स्तं)
1 Cursed, reviled.
2 Abandoned.
3 Pounded.
E.
अप implying contempt, &c. part. past. of ध्वस to go, also अवध्वस्त.

n. (-नं)
Evil thoughts, wickedness.
E.
अप, and ध्यान meditation.

n. (-नं)
1 Taking away, withdrawing, removing.
2 Destroying.
3 Dying.
4 Acquittance of a debt or obligation.
E.
अप from, णी to take, ल्युट् aff.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Taken away, removed.
2 Paid, discharged.
E.
अप from, णी to take, क्त aff.

ind.
1 Having taken away.
2 Having discharged.
E.
अप before, णी to take, य aff.

f. (-त्तिः)
Removing, taking or sending away.
E.
अप, नुद to send, क्तिन् aff.

m. (-दः)
Removing, taking away.
E.
अप, and नुद to send, affix घञ्.

n. (नं)
1 Removing, destroying.
2 Expiating.
E.
अप before, नुद to send, ल्युट् aff.

mfn. (-त्रः-त्रा-त्रं)
Of low caste, using separate vessels.
n. (-त्रं)
A separate vessel, one from which no one else will eat.
E.
अप apart, पात्र a vessel.

m. (-तः)
A person who has lost caste, one with whom his kindred will not eat or drink, from a common pātra or vessel.
E.
अपपात्र, and इतच् aff.

mfn. (-भीः-भीः-भि)
Fearless, undaunted.
E.
अप away, भी fear.

m. (-शः)
Ungrammatical language.
E.
अप from, भ्रंश to fall, and अच् affix; also अपभ्रंस.

m. (-मः)
Declination, (in astronomy.)
E.
अप, मा to measure, ड aff.

n. (-नं)
Disrespect, disgrace.
E.
अप reverse, and मन to respect, affix घञ्.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Disrespect, disgraced.
E.
अपमान disgrace, इतच् aff.

mfn. (-न्यः-न्या-न्यं)
Disreputable, dishonourable.
E.
अप before, मन to mind, ण्यत् aff.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Neglected in dress or person, unadorned.
2 Disrespected, disgraced.
E.
अप before, मा to measure, क्त aff.

n. (-कं)
Debt.
E.
अप from, मि to throw, and त्यकन् aff.

n. (-कं)
Property, &c. obtained by barter.
E.
अपमित्य having changed, ककन aff.

m. (-त्युः)
Sudden death, dying of some casualty, not of sickness or decay.
E.
अप, मृत्यु death.

n. (-शः)
Disgrace, infamy.
E.
अप before, यशस् fame.

mfn. (-रः-रा-रं)
Disgraceful, occasioning infamy.
E.
अपयशस्, and कर what makes.

n. (-नं)
Retreat, flight.
E.
अप from, and यान going.

mfn. (-रः-रा-रं)
1 Other.
2 Opposite, contrary.
3 Posterior, (in place or time.)
4 Similar, same.
5 Friendly, not adverse.
n. (-रं)
The hind quarter of an elephant.
f. (-रा)
1 The womb.
2 Suppressed menstruation in pregnancy.
3 The west.
E.
अ neg. and पर from पृ to nourish or fill, and अच् affix; or अ neg. and पर other.

n. (-रं)
The opposite bank of a river.
mfn. (-रः-रा-रं)
Unbounded, boundless, interminable.
E.
अ neg. पार shore.

ind.
Again, moreover.
E.
च the particle added to the last.

n. (-त्वं)
1 Opposition, contrariety.
2 Posteriorly, (in place or time); also अपरता f. (-ता.)
E.
त्व or तल् added to अपर.

m. (-तिः)
Stopping, ceasing.
E.
अप from, रम to please, and क्तिन् aff.

m. (-त्रः)
The end of the night, the last watch.
E.
अपर the end, रात्र from रात्रि a night.

n. (-कं)
Another world, paradise.
E.
अपर, and लोक world.

m. (-वः)
1 Contest, dispute.
2 Discord.
E.
अप, and रव sound.

n. (-क्त्रं)
A kind of metre of four lines, having every two lines the same.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Undisturbed, undisputed.
E.
अपरव, and उज्झित^1 free from.
[1] Correction submitted by Jim Funderburk on 20161130. Reference: https://github.com/sanskrit-lexicon/CORRECTIONS/issues/323, batch 301.

adj. mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) or adv. n. (-रं)
1 Continued, uninterrupted.
2 Continually, (applied to action.)
E.
अ neg. and परस्पर mutual.

mfn. (-खः-खी-खं)
Not having the head downwards or reverted.
2 Presenting a firm front in battle or danger.
E.
अ neg. पराङ्मुख reverted.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Unconquered, unsurpassed.
m. (-तः)
1 A name of ŚIVA.
2 Also of VIṢṆU.
3 A sage.
f. (-ता)
1 A name applied to several plants.
2 (Clitoria ternatea,) see गिरिकर्णी.
3 Aeschynomene sesban, see जया and,
4 Another plant, see अशनपर्णी.
5 A name of the goddess DURGĀ.
6 A species of the शर्करी metre of four lines, with fourteen syllables in each line.
7 The north-east quarter.
E.
अपर another, अ neg. and जित conquered, excelled, &c.

mfn. (यः-या-यं)
Unconquerable, invincible.
E.
अपर, and अजेय unconquerable.

mfn. (-द्धः-द्धा-द्धं)
1 Criminal, guilty.
2 Erring.
E.
अप before, राघ to accomplish, क्त aff.

m. (-त्कः)
An archer or arrow always missing the butt.
E.
अपराद्ध erring, and पृषत्क an arrow.

mfn. (-द्धा-द्ध्री-द्धृ)
Offending an offender.
E.
अप before, राध, with तृच aff.

m. (-धः)
Offence, transgression, fault.
E.
अप badly, and राध to accomplish, घञ् aff.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Criminated, condemned.
E.
अपराध and क्त aff.

f. (-ता)
Criminality, guilt. So अपराधित्व n. (-त्वं)
E.
तल् or त्व added to अपराध.

mfn. (-धी-धिनी-धि)
Offending, culpable, criminal.
E.
अपराध, and इनि aff.

mfn. (-नः-ना-नं)
Independent.
E.
अ neg. पराधीन dependant.

m. (-ह्लः)
Afternoon, the last watch of the day.
E.
अपर last, and अह्ण for अहन् a day.

mfn. (-नः-नी-नं)
Belonging to or produced in the close of the day, also अपराह्लेतन.
E.
अपराह्ल the end of a day, with द्यु, or द्युल् aff.

mfn. (तः-ता-तं)
1 Unknown.
2 Unseen.
E.
अ neg. परिकलित seen.

mfn. (-न्नः-न्ना-न्नं)
Dry, not moist, not liquid.
E.
अ neg. परिक्लिन्न moist.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Unknown, unobtained.
E.
अ neg. परिगत obtained.

m. (-हः)
Non-acceptance.
E.
अ neg. परिग्रह taking.

mfn. (-ह्यः-ह्या-ह्मं)
Unfit or improper to be accepted, not to be taken.
E.
अ neg. परिग्राह्य to be taken.

mfn. (-यी-यिनी-यि)
1 Without acquaintance.
2 Misanthropic.
E.
अ neg. परिचयिन् acquainted.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Unacquainted with, unknown to.
E.
अ neg. परिचित known.

mfn. (-यः-या-यं)
Unsociable.
E.
अ neg. परिचेय to be combined.

n. (-दं)
Absence of clothing, nudity.
E.
अ neg. परिच्छद covering.

mfn. (-न्नः-न्ना-न्नं)
Uncovered, unclothed. So अपरिच्छादित. mfn. (-तः-ता-तं).
E.
अ neg. परिच्छन्न or परिच्छादित clothed.

mfn. (-न्नः-न्ना-न्नं)
Continuous, connected without interval.
E.
अ neg. परिच्छिन्न intersected.

m. (-दः)
1 Want of arrangement or order.
2 Want of distinction or division.
E.
अ neg. परिच्छेद section.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Unarranged, not distinguished or divided.
E.
अ neg. परिच्छेदित intersected.

n. (-नं)
Celibacy.
E.
अ neg. परिणयन marrying.

f. (-ता)
